intro: A creamy, plant-based dessert crafted from blended silken tofu — smooth, dairy-free, and naturally lower in fat. Velvety and indulgent, it appeals to vegans, lactose-intolerant individuals, and anyone who believes dessert should feel as good as it tastes.

flavours.name: Black Sesame
flavours.desc: Creamy, nutty and intensely deep — a stunning jet-grey scoop finished with honeycomb brittle.

flavours.name: Coffee Hazelnut
flavours.desc: Bold cold-brew coffee folded with toasted hazelnut. Smooth, grown-up, never bitter.

flavours.name: Macadamia Brittle
flavours.desc: Clean soy-cream base loaded with buttery macadamia and caramel brittle shards.

flavours.name: Rum Raisin
flavours.desc: Plump rum-soaked raisins swirled through a mellow, fragrant cream. A classic.

flavours.name: Maple Walnut
flavours.desc: Toasted walnuts and warm maple in a soft, comforting soy-cream scoop.

flavours.name: Biscoff Crumble
flavours.desc: Spiced speculoos cream crowned with caramelised biscuit crumble.

flavours.name: Durian
flavours.desc: For the brave — rich Musang King durian, pure and unapologetic.

flavours.name: Salted Cheese
flavours.desc: Sweet-and-salty cheese cream — mellow, golden, surprisingly addictive.

flavours.name: Strawberry Shortcake
flavours.desc: Fresh strawberry compote and sponge crumble over clean soy-cream.
